rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for dairy butter.

example.english: I spread butter on toast in the morning.
example.traditional: 我朝早搽牛油喺多士上。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 caa4 ngau4 jau4 hai2 do1 si6 soeng6

rows.note: Use this ingredient-plus-醬 pattern for nut or seed butter, such as 花生醬 for peanut butter.

example.english: I usually spread peanut butter on bread for breakfast.
example.traditional: 我早餐通常喺麵包上搽花生醬。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zou2 caan1 tung1 soeng4 hai2 min6 baau1 soeng6 caa4 faa1 saang1 zoeng3
